outcome: Risk of first episode of wheezing
cohort: 2079 children with a mean age of 36.97 ± 40.27 months in Shanghai, China
finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of first episode of wheezing by age 3 and asthma by age 4, particularly in children without exclusive breastfeeding or postnatal smoking exposure.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of first episode of wheezing by age 3 and asthma by age 4.
gest_age: Significantly lower in the caesarean delivery group (specific values not provided)
